baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُظَٰهِرُونَ ... أُمَّهَٰتِهِمْ ... ٱلَّٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ... مُنكَرًا ... وَزُورًا
baseline_models.mechanism: A pronounced zihar formula attempts to move a woman from the wife category into the mother category. The ayah denies that transfer by tying motherhood to actual birth, then evaluates the attempted transfer as repudiated and false speech.

activation_trace.role: The literal zihar formula supplies the attempted legal-relational recategorization.
The women category identifies the persons whom the formula tries to reclassify.
The birth-mother image supplies the status claimed by the formula and then explicitly denied.
Actual childbirth supplies the constitutive event that verbal analogy cannot replace.
Audible utterance locates the attempted transfer in speech rather than in biological fact.
Repudiated ugliness marks the speech act as something to be rejected, not ratified.
Falsehood and deviation name the mismatch between the spoken classification and reality.

changed_reading.before: The formula establishes a maternal status by declaration.
changed_reading.after: The formula is an uttered but invalid recategorization: birth grounds motherhood, while speech can only falsely claim it.

baseline_models.mechanism: The back-versus-belly and layer-matching images make zihar a surface analogy laid over a relation. Mother as origin and childbirth as originating event resist that overlay: external correspondence cannot alter where the relation comes from.

activation_trace.role: The back as the side opposite the belly supplies the formula's bodily surface contrast.
Matching one layer over another supplies the inferred mechanism of analogical overlay.
Mother as source, center, and return point makes maternity an origin relation rather than a surface likeness.
Childbirth fixes the embodied origin against which the overlay is tested.

changed_reading.before: The back comparison is merely the technical wording of zihar.
changed_reading.after: The wording tries to overlay a bodily surface likeness on an origin relation, and the ayah refuses to let likeness rewrite source.

baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance does more than state an error. It attributes what is not so, prepares the false wording, and changes a familiar relation into one that is socially unrecognizable; the wrong is a manufactured deformation of the relationship.

activation_trace.role: Attributing words or a condition that was not so supplies the fabrication step.
Changing something until it is unknown or disliked supplies the relational defacement.
Preparing and dressing speech before utterance makes the false relation a constructed verbal product.

changed_reading.before: Munkar and zur are two general condemnations of an incorrect sentence.
changed_reading.after: They diagnose speech engineered to make a known marital relation socially unrecognizable while dressing that deformation as a usable formula.

baseline_models.mechanism: The close names two complementary repair motions: relinquishing punishment or erasing the offense's trace, then covering and protecting the offender from its consequence. Mercy leaves the classification false while keeping restoration open.

activation_trace.role: Leaving punishment and effacing guilt supplies the release side of repair.
The disappearance of an imprint supplies a material image for removing the offense's trace.
A covering that preserves what it covers supplies protection after effacement.
Covering guilt and shielding its bearer from the effect makes the restoration explicitly moral.

changed_reading.before: The final attributes are a general assurance appended to the rebuke.
changed_reading.after: The final attributes open a repair path that can erase the offense and protect its bearer without validating the false utterance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah places the formula inside an audible, tightly argued exchange between spouses. The woman's complaint and reciprocal speech prevent the man's declaration from occupying the scene as an uncontested performative; 58:2 reads as a judgment reached after both the claim and its resistance are heard.

activation_trace.role: The zihar formula supplies the unilateral relational claim being contested.
Repeated literal hearing makes both the initiating speech and its answer publicly cognizable before judgment.
Intertwined disputation gives the woman an active counter-position rather than a merely injured silence.
The marriage-partner relation identifies the actual bond that the maternal formula attempts to overwrite.
Back-and-forth review of speech turns the case into reciprocal discourse subject to correction.

structural_cues: 58:1 precedes the ruling and repeats hearing three times around one woman's speech.
The dual form in تَحَاوُرَكُمَا frames two-way exchange before 58:2 diagnoses the formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, spousehood, dispute, and reciprocal speech; I infer that the counter-speech blocks unilateral verbal closure. A live alternative is that 58:1 reports the complaint without altering the formula's legal mechanism.

changed_reading.after: 58:2 adjudicates a declaration already interrupted by the wife's heard counter-speech, so relational naming is answerable rather than unilateral.

context_deltas.mechanism: The false formula does not create motherhood, yet it creates a real procedural obstruction. Return toward the relation is routed through liberation before marital contact, and the sequence is named a distinguishing boundary. The speech is ontologically ineffective but legally consequential.

activation_trace.role: The pronounced statement supplies the false act whose consequences must be repaired.
Return after withdrawal supplies the movement back toward the suspended marital relation.
Freedom opposed to bondage supplies the reparative release demanded by the utterance.
The literal neck completes the embodied object of liberation and moves repair beyond counter-speech alone.
Marital touching supplies the blocked threshold that repair must precede.
A distinguishing barrier names the regulated edge between the utterance and resumed contact.

structural_cues: 58:3 links return, liberation, and pre-contact order with ثم and ف.
58:3-4 repeat مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا and then call the sequence God's limits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, liberation of a neck, a pre-contact sequence, and a boundary; I infer an utterance-to-obstruction-to-repair arrow. The live alternative is that يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا describes recurrence in the utterance rather than return to marital life.

changed_reading.before: Because the maternal claim is false, the words are simply void.
changed_reading.after: The words remain false as kinship but produce a temporary contact barrier that only embodied, ordered repair reopens.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later secret counsel, inward saying, boundary-crossing hostility, and intended grief place the focus utterance within a larger ecology of speech that rearranges social relations before any physical act. The formula's harm is therefore not exhausted by propositional falsity; language can isolate, threaten, and roughen another person's social world.

activation_trace.role: Making a familiar relation unrecognizable supplies the focus ayah's social deformation.
Secret mutual speech supplies a group channel in which harmful relational language circulates.
Crossing a limit unjustly supplies the direction by which discourse becomes social aggression.
Speech held within the self extends the spectrum from public formula to inwardly rehearsed claim.
The roughening of the self by grief supplies an affective outcome of manipulated discourse.

structural_cues: 58:8 repeats private counsel and saying while moving from collective speech to speech within the self.
58:8-10 name transgression and grief as products of the discourse sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secret counsel, inward saying, limit-crossing, and grief; I infer that these illuminate the social and affective force of the focus formula. A live alternative is that the later counsel concerns a separate communal abuse with no intended echo of zihar.

changed_reading.before: The focus formula is wrong because its sentence does not correspond to biological fact.
changed_reading.after: Its falsity is also relational force: like later harmful discourse, it can reorganize belonging and inflict social grief even while failing to alter kinship truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later chain of lying oaths explicitly made into a shield activates a contrast with غفور at the focus close. Fabricated speech is used to manufacture self-cover, whereas divine covering can protect after the false speech is exposed rather than conceal it from accountability.

activation_trace.role: Dressed and prepared false speech supplies the counterfeit protective technology.
A preserving cover supplies the authentic protection named after the offense is exposed.
The oath supplies a solemn speech form recruited for concealment.
Explicit opposition to truth identifies the oath as false rather than protective in itself.
The oath sense supplies the verbal material converted into defensive equipment.
The protective shield supplies the later material image for self-covering speech.

structural_cues: 58:14-16 form a contiguous oath, lie, and shield sequence.
58:2 exposes false speech before naming God as غفور, reversing concealment into accountable covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lying oaths used as a shield and the focus supplies divine covering; I infer a contrast between evasive self-cover and restorative cover. The live alternative is that the shared covering image is lexical activation without a deliberate surah-level contrast.

changed_reading.before: غفور only means that punishment may be forgiven after the false formula.
changed_reading.after: غفور also contrasts two coverings: speech that shields a lie from exposure and divine cover that becomes available once the lie is exposed and repaired.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later rule attaches material truthfulness and purification to privileged speech, yet immediately pairs inability with forgiveness and mercy. This strengthens the focus close as calibrated restoration: harmful speech can require cost and cleansing without making access to mercy depend on unlimited capacity.

activation_trace.role: Release from punishment keeps restoration open after the condemned utterance.
Material charity supplies a costly truth-bearing accompaniment to regulated private speech.
Purifying self and action from ugliness supplies the moral direction of the imposed cost.
Forgiving cover after inability prevents the speech regulation from becoming exclusion by means.
Tender mercy supplies accommodation alongside the demand for purification.

structural_cues: 58:12 places charity and purification before an explicit inability clause.
The verse closes that inability clause with غفور رحيم, repeating the focus root غ ف ر in another speech-regulation setting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech-related cost, purification, inability, forgiveness, and mercy; I infer a common repair logic with 58:2. A live alternative is that the two regulations share divine attributes but not a specific reparative mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The mercy close simply softens a categorical rebuke.
changed_reading.after: The mercy close anticipates a pattern in which speech is disciplined through embodied cost and cleansing while inability remains inside, rather than outside, restorative mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later verses preserve actual genealogical names yet deny them automatic protective or allegiance power. This distinguishes two questions that the focus initially appears to fuse: whether a kinship label is true, and what practical claim even true kinship may exert. The false mother label fails the first test; real offspring, fathers, sons, brothers, and clan still do not become absolute claims.

activation_trace.role: The actual mother relation supplies the focus ayah's protected genealogical category.
Actual offspring supply genuine kin whose existence does not guarantee protective efficacy.
Fatherhood and nurture begin the explicit ladder of genuine family relations.
Sonship as descent from an origin supplies a true genealogical bond whose allegiance claim is limited.
Brotherhood extends the genuine kinship inventory beyond direct descent.
Clan widens kinship into a social collective while retaining the same limit on absolute allegiance.

structural_cues: 58:17 denies that offspring can avail, then 58:22 enumerates father, son, brother, and clan.
The sequence moves from biological descent to widening circles of actual social kin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies genuine kin terms alongside denied protection and allegiance; I infer a distinction between category truth and category authority. A live alternative is that the later kin list concerns loyalty only and does not intentionally revise the maternal taxonomy of 58:2.

changed_reading.before: 58:2 protects biological kinship as the decisive relational order.
changed_reading.after: 58:2 protects the truth of kinship names, while later context shows that even true kinship has bounded practical authority and cannot be verbally fabricated into an absolute claim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the broader 'put behind and abandon' branch rather than treating ظ ه ر only as the technical zihar term. It remains anchored in the focus verb and gains contextual traction from return and blocked marital contact. Downstream prose should present it as a spatial echo of the formula's effect, not as the verb's direct lexical gloss here.

activation_trace.role: Putting something behind one's back supplies an exploratory image of abandoning the marital relation.
Return after withdrawal supplies the reverse movement toward the relationship.
Blocked marital contact makes the spatial abandonment socially operative rather than merely figurative.

changed_reading.before: Zihar only asserts a false maternal equivalence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also enacts putting the marital bond behind the speaker; return requires repair before contact can resume.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain contrast between fabricated oral classification and divinely established inner inscription. It remains valid because the focus twice anchors the offense in قول and the context explicitly places writing in hearts. Downstream prose should call it a compositional contrast, not claim that writing is the lexical opposite of saying.

activation_trace.role: Attributing what was not so supplies an unstable identity claim made by speech.
Inscription that establishes a binding condition supplies a durable counter-mode of identity formation.
The heart supplies the inward site where affiliation is established rather than merely pronounced.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts false speech only with biological fact.
changed_reading.after: The surah can also be heard contrasting a fabricated identity spoken onto another person with an affiliation established inwardly in the heart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it spatializes two social roles through branch images: spouse as joined counterpart and mother as source or center. It remains anchored in أمهاتهم and is activated by the immediately preceding زوجها. Downstream prose should retain it as a relational topology, not reduce wife and mother to dictionary antonyms.

activation_trace.role: Mother as source, center, and point of return supplies one relational position.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies the spouse's distinct relational position.

changed_reading.before: The formula substitutes one female kin label for another relation.
changed_reading.after: It collapses two different relational geometries: the joined counterpart is falsely renamed as the speaker's source and point of origin.

strongest_changes: The prior dialogue turns an apparently unilateral formula into a contested declaration heard together with the wife's resistance.
The formula is false as kinship yet consequential as procedure: it blocks contact until embodied repair crosses a named boundary.
Later lying oaths used as shields sharpen the difference between evasive self-cover and the restorative cover named by غفور.
Later genuine kin terms separate the truth of a relational name from the bounded authority that even true kinship may claim.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly materializes speech: dialogue contests it, liberation and delayed touch repair it, private counsel spreads its social force, oaths become shields, and truthful kinship is preserved without being made absolute. That sequence keeps 58:2 from collapsing into either mere semantics or mere penalty.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا means return to marital life, recurrence in the statement, or another return relation remains materially live.
The surface-overlay, putting-behind, and spoken-versus-written models are branch or compositional activations and should not be promoted to direct lexical glosses.
The contrast between counterfeit oath-shields and divine covering is coherent across the surah but may be an activated analogy rather than an intended explicit pairing.
The later kinship inventory clearly limits allegiance, but its degree of deliberate echo with the maternal denial remains uncertain.
